title: One Step, One Lead: Mitigating Higher-Order Interference in Multi-Domain Reinforcement Learning via Cross-Step Control
abstract: arXiv:2609.06469v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) across multiple domains can broaden the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet joint training often degrades individual-domain performance and can destabilize optimization. Existing work typically diagnoses such interference from a single-step view using first-order gradient alignment or curvature-based proxies. We show that this view can miss a critical form of sequential interference: same-point domain gradients may remain nearly orthogonal even when consecutive realized updates partially reverse one another in output space. We further show that consecutive token log-probability footprints recover this interaction directly from adjacent checkpoints as a local second-order interaction in output space, without explicitly reconstructing same-step curvature. translated_title: 一步一主导：通过跨步控制缓解多领域强化学习中的高阶干扰
translated_abstract: 跨多个领域的强化学习（RL）可以拓宽大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，但联合训练往往会降低各个单一领域的性能，并可能导致优化过程不稳定。现有工作通常从单步视角出发，使用一阶梯度对齐或基于曲率的代理指标来诊断这种干扰。我们证明这种视角可能会忽略一种关键的序列性干扰形式：即使连续的实际更新在输出空间中部分相互抵消，同一点的领域梯度仍可能保持近似正交。我们进一步表明，连续词元的对数概率足迹可以直接从相邻检查点中恢复这种交互，将其作为输出空间中的局部二阶交互，而无需显式重建同一步的曲率。基于这一洞察，我们提出了OSOL方法，该方法在每次迭代中指定一个重点领域，并利用前一个检查点的足迹……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出OSOL方法，通过分析相邻检查点间的词元对数概率足迹来捕捉传统单步梯度分析无法发现的跨步序列性干扰，并在每次迭代中指定重点领域，从而缓解多领域强化学习中的高阶干扰问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes OSOL, which detects sequential cross-step interference—missed by single-step gradient analysis—via token log-probability footprints from adjacent checkpoints, and designates a focus domain at each iteration to mitigate higher-order interference in multi-domain reinforcement learning.
